Nintendo games, NES through Switch

Find the official way back.

Where to Play is a browse catalog of Nintendo games: when they came out, who made them, and the official option when one is public. Nothing here is hosted, and nothing is for sale.

1822 games across NES, SNES, Nintendo 64, Game Boy, Game Boy Color, Game Boy Advance, GameCube, Wii, Wii U, Nintendo DS, Nintendo 3DS, and Nintendo Switch.
